answer: Each newcomer needs a sponsor with a 70-credit bond, sable-sealed. The newcomer files a comet-plume reading each epoch in the sable band. Peers re-measure the comet plume; wrong, reused, stale readings burn the newcomer's bond and decay the sponsor's bond 10%. First filing 38, the kth 38+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes cost 3,035,000 against a 40,000 pool, needing 334 sponsors, 3 each. Rented-sponsor rings fail on shared seals; honest newcomers pay 38 once.
